     5	 *
     6	 * Defines:

     8	 *   - PersonaMetadata    — typed representation of a persona YAML file
     9	 *   - SuiteConfig        — configuration for a single persona suite

    20	 *

    22	 * well-known values:

    24	 *   - `'claude-code'`  → Claude Code `.md` instruction files
    25	 *   - `'deep-agents'`  → Deep Agents `.md` instruction files

    42	 * as potentially absent and fall back to suite-level or shared defaults.

   124	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

   126	/**
   127	 * A single validation outcome returned by a plugin's `onValidate` hook.
   128	 */
   129	export interface ValidationResult {

   133	  message: string;

   137	// Plugin interface
   138	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   139	
   140	/**
   141	 * Interface that every persona build plugin must implement.
   142	 *
   143	 * All hooks are optional — a plugin only needs to implement the hooks it
   144	 * uses. The only required field is `name`, which is used for logging and
   145	 * identification.
   146	 *
   147	 * Hook invocation order (per persona):
   148	 *   1. onSuiteInit   — once per suite, before any persona is built
   149	 *   2. onBuildContext — per persona, before template rendering
   150	 *   3. onPostRender   — per persona, after body rendering
   151	 *   4. onValidate     — per persona, during the validation phase
   152	 */
   153	export interface PersonaBuildPlugin {
   154	  /**
   155	   * Unique name for this plugin (used in log messages and error reporting).
   156	   */
   157	  name: string;
   158	
   159	  /**
   160	   * Called once per suite before any persona is built.
   161	   *
   162	   * Use this hook to perform suite-level setup — e.g. loading external data,
   163	   * validating the suite config, or mutating `sharedMeta` for downstream hooks.
   164	   *
   165	   * @param suite      The suite configuration object
   166	   * @param sharedMeta Shared metadata merged from `_shared.yaml` (mutate in place if needed)
   167	   */
   168	  onSuiteInit?(suite: SuiteConfig, sharedMeta: Record<string, unknown>): void;
   169	
   170	  /**
   171	   * Called for each persona before template rendering.
   172	   *
   173	   * Receives the current rendering context and must return a (possibly mutated)
   174	   * context object. Plugins are chained: each plugin receives the output of the
   175	   * previous one.
   176	   *
   177	   * @param context  Current rendering context (accumulates across plugins)
   178	   * @param persona  Typed metadata for the persona being built
   179	   * @param suite    The suite configuration object
   180	   * @returns        Updated rendering context (must include all original keys)
   181	   */
   182	  onBuildContext?(
   183	    context: Record<string, unknown>,
   184	    persona: PersonaMetadata,
   185	    suite: SuiteConfig,
   186	    target?: TargetType,
   187	  ): Record<string, unknown>;
   188	
   189	  /**
   190	   * Called for each persona after body rendering.
   191	   *
   192	   * Receives the rendered output string and can return a mutated version.
   193	   * Plugins are chained: each plugin receives the output of the previous one.
   194	   *
   195	   * @param output  The rendered persona output string (accumulates across plugins)
   196	   * @param persona Typed metadata for the persona being built
   197	   * @param target  The current build target
   198	   * @returns       Updated output string
   199	   */
   200	  onPostRender?(output: string, persona: PersonaMetadata, target: TargetType): string;
   201	
   202	  /**
   203	   * Called during the validation phase for each persona.
   204	   *
   205	   * Return an array of ValidationResult objects (or an empty array).
   206	   * Results from all plugins are collected into a flat array by the runner.
   207	   *
   208	   * @param persona Typed metadata for the persona being built
   209	   * @param suite   The suite configuration object
   210	   * @param target  The current build target (optional — absent in single-target contexts)
   211	   * @returns       Array of validation results (may be empty)
   212	   */
   213	  onValidate?(persona: PersonaMetadata, suite: SuiteConfig, target?: TargetType): ValidationResult[];
   214	
   215	  /**
   216	   * Optional map of custom frontmatter templates keyed by target type.
   217	   *
   218	   * When present, the builder will use these templates in place of (or to
   219	   * augment) the library defaults for the matching target.
   220	   */
   221	  frontmatterTemplates?: Partial<Record<TargetType, string>>;
   222	}

   144	// Plugin interface
   145	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   146	
   147	/**
   148	 * Interface that every persona build plugin must implement.
   149	 *
   150	 * All hooks are optional — a plugin only needs to implement the hooks it
   151	 * uses. The only required field is `name`, which is used for logging and
   152	 * identification.
   153	 *
   154	 * Hook invocation order (per persona):
   155	 *   1. onSuiteInit      — once per suite, before any persona is built
   156	 *   2. onPartials        — once per suite, after partials are loaded
   157	 *   3. onBuildContext    — per persona, before template rendering
   158	 *   4. onPersonaPartials — per persona, before template rendering (after onBuildContext)
   159	 *   5. onPostRender      — per persona, after body rendering
   160	 *   6. onValidate        — per persona, during the validation phase
   161	 */
   162	export interface PersonaBuildPlugin {
   163	  /**
   164	   * Unique name for this plugin (used in log messages and error reporting).
   165	   */
   166	  name: string;
   167	
   168	  /**
   169	   * Called once per suite before any persona is built.
   170	   *
   171	   * Use this hook to perform suite-level setup — e.g. loading external data,
   172	   * validating the suite config, or mutating `sharedMeta` for downstream hooks.
   173	   *
   174	   * @param suite      The suite configuration object
   175	   * @param sharedMeta Shared metadata merged from `_shared.yaml` (mutate in place if needed)
   176	   */
   177	  onSuiteInit?(suite: SuiteConfig, sharedMeta: Record<string, unknown>): void;
   178	
   179	  /**
   180	   * Called once per suite after partials are loaded from disk (and after any
   181	   * `BuildConfig.partials` inline map has been applied), but before any persona
   182	   * is rendered.
   183	   *
   184	   * Plugins are chained: each plugin receives the accumulated partials map
   185	   * returned by the previous plugin. Return the (possibly mutated or extended)
   186	   * map to pass it to the next plugin.
   187	   *
   188	   * @param partialsMap The current map of partial name → partial content
   189	   * @param suiteName   The identifier of the current suite
   190	   * @param suite       The suite configuration object
   191	   * @returns           Updated partials map (must include all original keys)
   192	   */
   193	  onPartials?(
   194	    partialsMap: Record<string, string>,
   195	    suiteName: string,
   196	    suite: SuiteConfig,
   197	  ): Record<string, string>;
   198	
   199	  /**
   200	   * Called for each persona before template rendering.
   201	   *
   202	   * Receives the current rendering context and must return a (possibly mutated)
   203	   * context object. Plugins are chained: each plugin receives the output of the
   204	   * previous one.
   205	   *
   206	   * @param context  Current rendering context (accumulates across plugins)
   207	   * @param persona  Typed metadata for the persona being built
   208	   * @param suite    The suite configuration object
   209	   * @returns        Updated rendering context (must include all original keys)
   210	   */
   211	  onBuildContext?(
   212	    context: Record<string, unknown>,
   213	    persona: PersonaMetadata,
   214	    suite: SuiteConfig,
   215	    target?: TargetType,
   216	  ): Record<string, unknown>;
   217	
   218	  /**
   219	   * Called for each persona (and target) after `onBuildContext`, before
   220	   * template rendering.
   221	   *
   222	   * Allows plugins to inject or override partials on a per-persona basis.
   223	   * Plugins are chained: each plugin receives the accumulated partials map
   224	   * returned by the previous plugin. Return the (possibly mutated or extended)
   225	   * map to pass it to the next plugin.
   226	   *
   227	   * @param partialsMap The current map of partial name → partial content
   228	   * @param persona     Typed metadata for the persona being built
   229	   * @param context     The rendering context built by `onBuildContext`
   230	   * @param suite       The suite configuration object
   231	   * @param target      The current build target (optional)
   232	   * @returns           Updated partials map (must include all original keys)
   233	   */
   234	  onPersonaPartials?(
   235	    partialsMap: Record<string, string>,
   236	    persona: PersonaMetadata,
   237	    context: Record<string, unknown>,
   238	    suite: SuiteConfig,
   239	    target?: TargetType,
   240	  ): Record<string, string>;
   241	
   242	  /**
   243	   * Called for each persona after body rendering.
   244	   *
   245	   * Receives the rendered output string and can return a mutated version.
   246	   * Plugins are chained: each plugin receives the output of the previous one.
   247	   *
   248	   * @param output  The rendered persona output string (accumulates across plugins)
   249	   * @param persona Typed metadata for the persona being built
   250	   * @param target  The current build target
   251	   * @returns       Updated output string
   252	   */
   253	  onPostRender?(output: string, persona: PersonaMetadata, target: TargetType): string;
   254	
   255	  /**
   256	   * Called during the validation phase for each persona.
   257	   *
   258	   * Return an array of ValidationResult objects (or an empty array).
   259	   * Results from all plugins are collected into a flat array by the runner.
   260	   *
   261	   * @param persona Typed metadata for the persona being built
   262	   * @param suite   The suite configuration object
   263	   * @param target  The current build target (optional — absent in single-target contexts)
   264	   * @returns       Array of validation results (may be empty)
   265	   */
   266	  onValidate?(persona: PersonaMetadata, suite: SuiteConfig, target?: TargetType): ValidationResult[];
   267	
   268	  /**
   269	   * Optional map of custom frontmatter templates keyed by target type.
   270	   *
   271	   * When present, the builder will use these templates in place of (or to
   272	   * augment) the library defaults for the matching target.
   273	   */
   274	  frontmatterTemplates?: Partial<Record<TargetType, string>>;
   275	}
